items: A tapered brick tower with a cap and a cross of sails on the -z face. h is the tower, the sails reach sail_len beyond the hub.
Tapered tower h tall plus a glazed lantern of height lantern on top — total h + lantern.
Legs and a braced ring carrying a tank; h is the total height, the tank is the top tank_h of it.
A cylindrical silo h tall with a cone roof of height cone — total h + cone.
A slender tapered tower h tall with a balcony gallery at balcony x h (0.7 = seven tenths up).
Mast h tall, nacelle and three blades of length blade — the tip reaches h + blade.
An icosphere hemisphere: 2r across, r tall. detail 1 = 80 faces, 2 = 320, 3 = 1280.
A conical marquee of radius r and height h on `sides` panels.
A garden pavilion: a deck, `posts` posts h tall and a conical roof roof_h high — total h + roof_h.
A tapered square shaft h tall, w square at the base, with a pyramidion.
A triumphal arch w x h x d with a single opening opening_w wide and opening_h high.
A polygonal spire h tall on a short base, `sides` faces.
A ziggurat: `steps` square steps, w at the base, h tall in total.
An elliptical stepped ring of stands, 2rx by 2rz on plan; `tiers` tiers of tier_h high and tier_d deep, the top tier at the full radius.
A big wheel of radius r on raking legs, with `cabins` cabins on the rim.
